title: Artificial intelligence-enabled multipurpose smart detection in active-matrix electrowetting-on-dielectric digital microfluidics.
summary: U-Net and YOLOv8 models are used in an AM-EWOD lab-on-chip system, with droplet-splitting and single-cell detection evaluated against manual verification, giving a distinct field result with a clear AI role. AI role: U-Net and YOLOv8 computer-vision models. The article appeared in Microsystems & Nanoengineering.
